# Local inbox state

- Owner: <your name>.
- RainCLI identity: `<your-inbox-handle>`, team `<team-slug>` (confirm with `raincli whoami`).
- Credential path: `~/.config/raincli/agent.json` (secret; do not print or share).
- Workspace: `~/herdr/inbox-agent`.
- Approved shareable context: `<absolute path, e.g. /home/you/raincli-shareable>` only, plus current conversation attachments.
- Connector config: `~/.config/raincli/connector.json` (inbox mode; runs in its own pane).
- Main-session escalation: `<main agent name and pane id>`, or "not mapped" (then use the pending-question fallback in INBOX.md).
